LanguageData.MX_Neiyu_Form_Flower.label: Neiyu: Flower Form
LanguageData.MX_Neiyu_Form_Flower.description: The flower-form armament Neiyu usually carries in hand. Gentle and light in appearance, it is in fact one of the three weapon forms her projection manifests in this world. The glow flowing between its petals is never ostentatious, yet it always carries a steady and tender strength.
LanguageData.MX_Neiyu_Form_Flower.tools.0.label: Flower Sweep
LanguageData.MX_Neiyu_Form_Weapon.label: Neiyu: Sword Form
LanguageData.MX_Neiyu_Form_Weapon.description: The sword-form armament transformed from the flower state. Its edge is condensed and its presence severe, making it Neiyu's most oppressive stance in frontal slashes and high-speed charges.
LanguageData.MX_Neiyu_Form_Weapon.tools.0.label: Neon Blade
LanguageData.MX_Neiyu_Form_Bow.label: Neiyu: Bow Form
LanguageData.MX_Neiyu_Form_Bow.description: The bow-form armament transformed from the flower state. Featherlight brilliance gathers on the string, and its arrows fall like rain, excelling at elegant sustained suppression from mid to long range.
LanguageData.MX_Bullet_BigSplitArrow.label: Neiyu: Rending Main Arrow
LanguageData.MX_Bullet_HomingShard.label: Neiyu: Pursuing Feather Shard
LanguageData.MX_Bullet_BarrageArrow.label: Neiyu: Flowfeather Arrow
